style: Museum-grade oil painting in the 19th-century biblical landscape tradition, Rembrandt chiaroscuro: deep indigo and blue-black shadows, burnished warm gold light, visible confident brushwork, aged varnish and fine craquelure, reverent and restrained, cinematic depth with atmospheric haze. Vertical 9:16 composition. Keep the lower third calm and darker so text can sit over it. Absolutely no text, letters, writing, signatures or logos. Human figures seen from behind or in silhouette, faces not detailed. No depiction of God, no halos, no glowing beings, no fantasy elements.

plates.joshua: An aged Joshua, a white-bearded elderly Israelite leader in a simple undyed wool mantle, leaning on a wooden staff, seen from behind and slightly to the side, standing on a rocky hilltop at dusk in the upper-middle of the frame. Below him the vast hill country of Canaan unfolds in layer after layer of blue mist: ridges, terraced valleys, a faint silver thread of the Jordan river far away, the last golden light catching the hilltops. He is small; the land is enormous and unfinished.
plates.highplaces: Dusk over a small Canaanite hilltop village of mud-brick houses with flat roofs. On a bare rise beside it: a rough stone altar with a thin column of smoke rising straight up, a carved wooden asherah pole and two standing stones. Faint firelight flickers in a doorway. The mood is calm and quietly ominous, not violent. Far below in the valley, tiny Israelite tents with cooking fires.
plates.lots: Night at the camp of Gilgal, around 1400 BCE. In the background a ring of twelve rough unhewn standing stones under a deep starry sky. In the foreground, seen in three-quarter FRONT view from the side, Eleazar the High Priest: an old man with a grey beard, his face half in shadow, wearing the High Priest's garments correctly: a long white linen robe, over it a sleeveless blue robe (me'il) with small golden bells and pomegranates at the hem, a woven ephod of gold, blue, purple and scarlet tied at the waist, two onyx stones set in gold on top of his two shoulder straps, and the square jewelled breastplate (choshen) with twelve different gemstones in four rows of three worn on his CHEST, in front, tied to the ephod by gold chains; on his head a white linen turban with a gold plate across the forehead. Nothing on his back. Beside him an old leader in a plain dark wool mantle (Joshua), also seen from the side. Between them a large clay urn; Eleazar lifts a small stone lot from it. On a low wooden table an unrolled parchment map lit by a single oil lamp. Behind them, in shadow, bearded tribal elders in simple wool robes and head coverings, ordinary men, not hooded figures.
plates.caleb: An old but powerful warrior, eighty-five years old, long white beard, wearing Late Bronze Age gear: a simple tunic, a leather and bronze scale corselet, a bronze-headed spear; no Roman, Greek or medieval armour, no helmet plume. Seen from behind at three-quarter view, climbing a steep rocky path toward a fortified hilltop city at dawn (ancient Hebron, Late Bronze Age). The city walls are massive cyclopean walls of huge rough unhewn boulders, with mudbrick upper courses and a plain gate; flat-roofed stone and mudbrick houses behind them. Absolutely NO medieval castle: no crenellations, no battlements, no square castle towers, no arches, no domes, no churches, no minarets. The first sunlight breaks over the ridge behind the city and rims him in gold. Defiant, determined, small against the mountain.

details: Biblical-era accuracy: Late Bronze / Iron Age material culture only
Priestly garments as described in Exodus 28: breastplate on the chest, onyx stones on the shoulders, tzitz on the forehead
No medieval, Roman or modern architecture or dress
